tr.sahih: By those [angels] lined up in rows
tr.pickthall: By those who set the ranks in battle order

tr.sahih: And those who drive [the clouds]
tr.pickthall: And those who drive away (the wicked) with reproof

tr.sahih: And those who recite the message,
tr.pickthall: And those who read (the Word) for a reminder,

tr.sahih: Indeed, your God is One,
tr.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is surely One;

ayahs.text: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ

tr.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.
tr.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the sun's risings.

ayahs.text: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
tr.pickthall: Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets;

tr.sahih: And as protection against every rebellious devil
tr.pickthall: With security from every froward devil.

ayahs.text: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ

tr.sahih: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
tr.pickthall: They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side,

tr.sahih: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,
tr.pickthall: Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment;

ayahs.text: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ

tr.sahih: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
tr.pickthall: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame.

ayahs.text: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍۭ

tr.sahih: Then inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created them [i.e., men] from sticky clay.
tr.pickthall: Then ask them (O Muhammad): Are they stronger as a creation, or those (others) whom we have created? Lo! We created them of plastic clay.

tr.sahih: But you wonder, while they mock,
tr.pickthall: Nay, but thou dost marvel when they mock

tr.sahih: And when they are reminded, they remember not.
tr.pickthall: And heed not when they are reminded,

tr.sahih: And when they see a sign, they ridicule.
tr.pickthall: And seek to scoff when they behold a portent.

ayahs.text: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

tr.sahih: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
tr.pickthall: And they say: Lo! this is mere magic;

ayahs.text: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

tr.sahih: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
tr.pickthall: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)?

tr.sahih: And our forefathers [as well]?"
tr.pickthall: And our forefathers?

tr.sahih: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."
tr.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): Ye, in truth; and ye will be brought low.

ayahs.text: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

tr.sahih: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.
tr.pickthall: There is but one Shout, and lo! they behold,

tr.sahih: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."
tr.pickthall: And say: Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgment.

ayahs.text: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

tr.sahih: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
tr.pickthall: This is the Day of Separation, which ye used to deny.

ayahs.text: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ

tr.sahih: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
tr.pickthall: (And it is said unto the angels): Assemble those who did wrong, together with their wives and what they used to worship

ayahs.text: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

tr.sahih: Other than Allāh, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
tr.pickthall: Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell;

tr.sahih: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
tr.pickthall: And stop them, for they must be questioned.

tr.sahih: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"
tr.pickthall: What aileth you that ye help not one another?

tr.sahih: But they, that Day, are in surrender.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but this day they make full submission.

tr.sahih: And they will approach one another asking [i.e., blaming] each other.
tr.pickthall: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.

ayahs.text: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

tr.sahih: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."
tr.pickthall: They say: Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the truth).

tr.sahih: They [i.e., the oppressors] will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,
tr.pickthall: They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers.

ayahs.text: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَـٰغِينَ

tr.sahih: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
tr.pickthall: We had no power over you, but ye were wayward folk.

ayahs.text: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ

tr.sahih: So the word [i.e., decree] of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
tr.pickthall: Now the Word of our Lord hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom).

tr.sahih: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."
tr.pickthall: Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray.

tr.sahih: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
tr.pickthall: Then lo! this day they (both) are sharers in the doom.

tr.sahih: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.
tr.pickthall: Lo! thus deal We with the guilty.

ayahs.text: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allāh," were arrogant
tr.pickthall: For when it was said unto them, There is no Allah save Allah, they were scornful

ayahs.text: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍۭ

tr.sahih: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"
tr.pickthall: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet?

tr.sahih: Rather, he [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him).

tr.sahih: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
tr.pickthall: Lo! (now) verily ye taste the painful doom -

ayahs.text: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
tr.pickthall: Ye are requited naught save what ye did -

tr.sahih: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.
tr.pickthall: Save single-minded slaves of Allah;

tr.sahih: Those will have a provision determined -
tr.pickthall: For them there is a known provision,

tr.sahih: Fruits; and they will be honored
tr.pickthall: Fruits. And they will be honoured

tr.sahih: In gardens of pleasure
tr.pickthall: In the Gardens of delight,

tr.sahih: On thrones facing one another.
tr.pickthall: On couches facing one another;

tr.sahih: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
tr.pickthall: A cup from a gushing spring is brought round for them,

tr.sahih: White and delicious to the drinkers;
tr.pickthall: White, delicious to the drinkers,

ayahs.text: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ

tr.sahih: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
tr.pickthall: Wherein there is no headache nor are they made mad thereby.

tr.sahih: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
tr.pickthall: And with them are those of modest gaze, with lovely eyes,

tr.sahih: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
tr.pickthall: (Pure) as they were hidden eggs (of the ostrich).

tr.sahih: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
tr.pickthall: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.

ayahs.text: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌ

tr.sahih: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth].
tr.pickthall: A speaker of them saith: Lo! I had a comrade

tr.sahih: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe
tr.pickthall: Who used to say: Art thou in truth of those who put faith (in his words)?

ayahs.text: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ

tr.sahih: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
tr.pickthall: Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and bones - can we (then) verily be brought to book?

tr.sahih: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"
tr.pickthall: He saith: Will ye look?

tr.sahih: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
tr.pickthall: Then looketh he and seeth him in the depth of hell.

tr.sahih: He will say, "By Allāh, you almost ruined me.
tr.pickthall: He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin,

ayahs.text: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ

tr.sahih: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
tr.pickthall: And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I too had been of those haled forth (to doom).

tr.sahih: Then, are we not to die
tr.pickthall: Are we then not to die

ayahs.text: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ

tr.sahih: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
tr.pickthall: Saving our former death, and are we not to be punished?

tr.sahih: Indeed, this is the great attainment.
tr.pickthall: Lo! this is the supreme triumph.

tr.sahih: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
tr.pickthall: For the like of this, then, let the workers work.

ayahs.text: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

tr.sahih: Is that [i.e., Paradise] a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm?
tr.pickthall: Is this better as a welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum?

tr.sahih: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We have appointed it a torment for wrong-doers.

ayahs.text: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
tr.pickthall: Lo! it is a tree that springeth in the heart of hell.

tr.sahih: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.
tr.pickthall: Its crop is as it were the heads of devils

ayahs.text: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
tr.pickthall: And lo! they verily must eat thereof, and fill (their) bellies therewith.

ayahs.text: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ

tr.sahih: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
tr.pickthall: And afterward, lo! thereupon they have a drink of boiling water

tr.sahih: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
tr.pickthall: And afterward, lo! their return is surely unto hell.

tr.sahih: Indeed they found their fathers astray.
tr.pickthall: They indeed found their fathers astray,

tr.sahih: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
tr.pickthall: But they make haste (to follow) in their footsteps.

tr.sahih: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
tr.pickthall: And verily most of the men of old went astray before them,

tr.sahih: And We had already sent among them warners.
tr.pickthall: And verily We sent among them warners.

tr.sahih: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
tr.pickthall: Then see the nature of the consequence for those warned,

tr.sahih: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.
tr.pickthall: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.

tr.sahih: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.
tr.pickthall: And Noah verily prayed unto Us, and gracious was the Hearer of his prayer

tr.sahih: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
tr.pickthall: And We saved him and his household from the great distress,

tr.sahih: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
tr.pickthall: And made his seed the survivors,

tr.sahih: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
tr.pickthall: And left for him among the later folk (the salutation):

tr.sahih: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."
tr.pickthall: Peace be unto Noah among the peoples!

tr.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
tr.pickthall: Lo! thus do We reward the good.

tr.sahih: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
tr.pickthall: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.

tr.sahih: Then We drowned the others [i.e., disbelievers].
tr.pickthall: Then We did drown the others.

tr.sahih: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
tr.pickthall: And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham

tr.sahih: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart
tr.pickthall: When he came unto his Lord with a whole heart;

ayahs.text: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ

tr.sahih: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?
tr.pickthall: When he said unto his father and his folk: What is it that ye worship?

tr.sahih: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allāh you desire?
tr.pickthall: Is it a falsehood - gods beside Allah - that ye desire?

tr.sahih: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
tr.pickthall: What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds?

tr.sahih: And he cast a look at the stars.
tr.pickthall: And he glanced a glance at the stars

tr.sahih: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."
tr.pickthall: Then said: Lo! I feel sick!

tr.sahih: So they turned away from him, departing.
tr.pickthall: And they turned their backs and went away from him.

tr.sahih: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
tr.pickthall: Then turned he to their gods and said: Will ye not eat?

tr.sahih: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?".
tr.pickthall: What aileth you that ye speak not?

tr.sahih: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
tr.pickthall: Then he attacked them, striking with his right hand.

tr.sahih: Then they [i.e., the people] came toward him, hastening.
tr.pickthall: And (his people) came toward him, hastening.

tr.sahih: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
tr.pickthall: He said: Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve

tr.sahih: While Allāh created you and that which you do?"
tr.pickthall: When Allah hath created you and what ye make?

tr.pickthall: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire.

tr.sahih: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the most debased.
tr.pickthall: And they designed a snare for him, but We made them the undermost.

tr.pickthall: And he said: Lo! I am going unto my Lord Who will guide me.

tr.sahih: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
tr.pickthall: My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous.

tr.pickthall: And We gave them the clear Scripture

words.gloss: And We guided both of them

tr.sahih: And We guided them on the straight path.
tr.pickthall: And showed them the right path.

tr.sahih: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:
tr.pickthall: And We left for them among the later folk (the salutation):

tr.sahih: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."
tr.pickthall: Peace be unto Moses and Aaron!

tr.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
tr.pickthall: Lo! thus do We reward the good.

tr.sahih: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.
tr.pickthall: Lo! they are two of Our believing slaves.

tr.sahih: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,
tr.pickthall: And lo! Elias was of those sent (to warn),

tr.sahih: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allāh?
tr.pickthall: When he said unto his folk: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

tr.sahih: Do you call upon Baʿl and leave the best of creators -
tr.pickthall: Will ye cry unto Baal and forsake the Best of creators,

tr.sahih: Allāh, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"
tr.pickthall: Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers?

tr.sahih: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
tr.pickthall: But they denied him, so they surely will be haled forth (to the doom)

tr.sahih: Except the chosen servants of Allāh.
tr.pickthall: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.

tr.sahih: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
tr.pickthall: And we left for him among the later folk (the salutation):

tr.sahih: "Peace upon Elias."
tr.pickthall: Peace be unto Elias!

tr.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
tr.pickthall: Lo! thus do We reward the good.

tr.sahih: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
tr.pickthall: Lo! he is one of our believing slaves.

tr.sahih: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.
tr.pickthall: And lo! Lot verily was of those sent (to warn).

tr.sahih: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,
tr.pickthall: When We saved him and his household, every one,

tr.sahih: Except an old woman [i.e., his wife] among those who remained [with the evildoers].
tr.pickthall: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind;

tr.sahih: Then We destroyed the others.
tr.pickthall: Then We destroyed the others.

tr.sahih: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
tr.pickthall: And lo! ye verily pass by (the ruin of) them in the morning

tr.sahih: And at night. Then will you not use reason?
tr.pickthall: And at night-time; have ye then no sense?

tr.sahih: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.
tr.pickthall: And lo! Jonah verily was of those sent (to warn)

tr.sahih: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
tr.pickthall: When he fled unto the laden ship,

tr.sahih: And he drew lots and was among the losers.
tr.pickthall: And then drew lots and was of those rejected;

tr.sahih: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.
tr.pickthall: And the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy;

tr.sahih: And had he not been of those who exalt Allāh,
tr.pickthall: And had he not been one of those who glorify (Allah)

ayahs.text: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

tr.sahih: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.
tr.pickthall: He would have tarried in its belly till the day when they are raised;

tr.sahih: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
tr.pickthall: Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick;

tr.sahih: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.
tr.pickthall: And We caused a tree of gourd to grow above him;

ayahs.text: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ

tr.sahih: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
tr.pickthall: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (folk) or more

tr.sahih: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.
tr.pickthall: And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while.

tr.sahih: So inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?
tr.pickthall: Now ask them (O Muhammad): Hath thy Lord daughters whereas they have sons?

ayahs.text: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَـٰثًا وَهُمْ شَـٰهِدُونَ

tr.sahih: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"
tr.pickthall: Or created We the angels females while they were present?

tr.sahih: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
tr.pickthall: Lo! it is of their falsehood that they say:

tr.sahih: "Allāh has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.
tr.pickthall: Allah hath begotten. Allah! verily they tell a lie.

tr.sahih: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
tr.pickthall: (And again of their falsehood): He hath preferred daughters to sons.

tr.sahih: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
tr.pickthall: What aileth you? How judge ye?

tr.sahih: Then will you not be reminded?
tr.pickthall: Will ye not then reflect?

tr.sahih: Or do you have a clear authority?
tr.pickthall: Or have ye a clear warrant?

tr.sahih: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.
tr.pickthall: Then produce your writ, if ye are truthful.

ayahs.text: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ

tr.sahih: And they have made [i.e., claimed] between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought [to punishment].
tr.pickthall: And they imagine kinship between him and the jinn, whereas the jinn know well that they will be brought before (Him).

tr.sahih: Exalted is Allāh above what they describe,
tr.pickthall: Glorified be Allah from that which they attribute (unto Him),

tr.sahih: Except the chosen servants of Allāh [who do not share in that sin].
tr.pickthall: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.

tr.sahih: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
tr.pickthall: Lo! verily, ye and that which ye worship,

tr.sahih: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
tr.pickthall: Ye cannot excite (anyone) against Him.

tr.sahih: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.
tr.pickthall: Save him who is to burn in hell.

ayahs.text: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ

tr.sahih: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
tr.pickthall: There is not one of us but hath his known position.

tr.sahih: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
tr.pickthall: Lo! we, even we are they who set the ranks,

tr.sahih: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allāh."
tr.pickthall: Lo! we, even we are they who hymn His praise

tr.sahih: And indeed, they [i.e., the disbelievers] used to say,
tr.pickthall: And indeed they used to say:

ayahs.text: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
tr.pickthall: If we had but a reminder from the men of old

tr.sahih: We would have been the chosen servants of Allāh."
tr.pickthall: We would be single-minded slaves of Allah.

tr.sahih: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.
tr.pickthall: Yet (now that it is come) they disbelieve therein; but they will come to know.

tr.sahih: And Our word [i.e., decree] has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
tr.pickthall: And verily Our word went forth of old unto Our bondmen sent (to warn)

tr.sahih: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
tr.pickthall: That they verily would be helped,

tr.sahih: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers [i.e., the believers] will be those who overcome.
tr.pickthall: And that Our host, they verily would be the victors.

tr.sahih: So, [O Muḥammad], leave them for a time.
tr.pickthall: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) awhile,

tr.sahih: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
tr.pickthall: And watch, for they will (soon) see.

tr.sahih: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?
tr.pickthall: Would they hasten on Our doom?

ayahs.text: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ

tr.sahih: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
tr.pickthall: But when it cometh home to them, then it will be a hapless morn for those who have been warned.

tr.sahih: And leave them for a time.
tr.pickthall: Withdraw from them awhile

tr.sahih: And see, for they are going to see.
tr.pickthall: And watch, for they will (soon) see.

ayahs.text: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

tr.sahih: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
tr.pickthall: Glorified be thy Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they attribute (unto Him)

tr.sahih: And peace upon the messengers.
tr.pickthall: And peace be unto those sent (to warn).

tr.sahih: And praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
tr.pickthall: And praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds!
